'''February 2001 Rochester tournament (10 February)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at Millennium Games, Rochester, NY on 10 February 2001. [[Reid Smith]] won it. It is known from R. Smith's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1727">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-12-rochester-ny-2-10-2001d1727/ rochester-ny-2-10-2001], DeckTech (R. "Voice of Law" Smith, 12 February 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-12-rochester-ny-2-10-2001d1727/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 10 February 2001
* '''Site:''' Millennium Games, Rochester, NY
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 8
* '''Winner:''' [[Reid Smith]]
